title: Choose the visual world for Budget Flow
question: The roll assigned Ulm Precision. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ulm Precision
options.lineage: Ulm School of Design and Braun product graphics, 1955-1975
options.thesis: Every number on screen is an equation you can check.
options.viewport: Charcoal side rail; the work area opens on a month equation (In − Out = Net) beside total balance, budgets and recent transactions below.
options.risk: Turns austere and cold if the greys go flat or the ochre accent spreads beyond the one primary action.

raised.raise: Transaction rows change state in place (pending to completed or cancelled) inside fixed columns; the grid never jumps.
One fixed magnitude ramp for money figures, five sizes; hierarchy is never improvised.
Layout reflows by whole grid modules and every amount aligns on one tabular column.
Nothing labelled twice: a column header or an equation operator carries meaning, never both.
Charts across months and budgets share one fixed scale so periods compare honestly.

options.label: Bahi-Khata Ledger
options.lineage: Indian merchants' red cloth account books and the Chopda Pujan ritual
options.thesis: Your money kept like a merchant's books, opened fresh every year.
options.viewport: Vermilion rail like a ledger's spine; balances and the month's in and out set in indigo with turmeric marking the add action.
options.risk: Strongest identification for Indian users but narrower internationally; ruled-paper detailing can slide into costume.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Friendly money: soft cards and one colour that always means you can act.
options.viewport: Single column of cards: balance, month progress, budgets, recent items, one bright add button.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and feels instantly familiar to everyday app users; loses on making numbers feel checkable and traceable.
options.risk: Close to many finance apps; personality depends on copy more than form.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Transactions as departures that settle in place.
options.viewport: A board of transaction rows whose status cells flip from pending to done.
options.case: People don't identify money with travel boards; the dark board fights daily calm.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty costume on a working screen.
options.kept: State changes in place without breaking the grid.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Spending mapped like stars by magnitude.
options.viewport: Categories plotted as sized dots on a chart field.
options.case: Poetic but obscures exact amounts; weak link to everyday money.
options.kept: One fixed magnitude ramp carries hierarchy.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid itself as the visible armature.
options.viewport: Balances in grid-built numerals on a visible grid.
options.case: Overlaps the assigned direction's grid discipline with less warmth and weaker money vernacular.
options.risk: Poster energy on a daily tool.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.viewport: Black field with a single plotted cash-flow trace.
options.case: Coded labels fight 'trustworthy numbers'; hides what should be plain.
options.risk: Cool and cryptic for a daily finance tool.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Months as plates on one fixed scale.
options.viewport: Month plates side by side at the same scale.
options.case: Lovely for review, slow for daily logging; drifts toward decoration.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, KPI cards for balance, income and spending, a donut of categories, recent transactions table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
